title: ATDD Registry Index Schema
description: A catalog of admittable artifacts: canonical ids + aliases + tags + versions. Aliases are UX; canonical ids are authoritative for lockfiles.

behaviour_digest_algo.description: Names the recipe that produced `behaviour_digest` — e.g. `sha256-behaviour-v1`. Required for the digest to be comparable ACROSS TIME: the publisher's file set is not frozen, so a digest alone cannot distinguish 'the package changed' from 'the recipe changed'. A consumer that does not recognise the algo reports COULD_NOT_CHECK rather than a drift storm across every package at once (#1878).

behaviour_digest.description: Publisher's digest over the files that decide what this package ENFORCES (manifest, convention nodes, detector sources; fixtures and tests excluded). NOT comparable to the install digest core records in substrate.lock.yaml, which covers every file — a consumer must store this published value and compare it against a later index, never against its own digest. May be null when the publisher's globs matched nothing, which is COULD_NOT_CHECK, not 'no drift' (#1878).
